newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Queensland govt survives no confidence motion.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Queensland govt survives no confidence motion.

text.p: The Queensland state government on Thursday survived a Labor opposition no-confidence motion after an independent MP sided with the Government.
The vote, taken in front of a packed house, was decided after a 44 vote went in favour of the government via a casting vote in favour by the parliament speaker Jim Fouras.
The no-confidence motion was moved by the Labor opposition following the resignation of Criminal Justice Commission head Ken Carruthers who was inquiring into pre-election deals.
Government deputy premier Joan Sheldon told the house the motion should "bring to an end once and for all Labor's destructive campaign".
